sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 105

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 105:1
items.html: When the ten Sefirot of direct light are clothed in the reflected light that ascends from a coupling by striking upon a screen of phase four, which clothes the direct light up to Keter, this is called “the clothing of Ein Sof in Keter.” And if the level of the reflected light is from phase three, it is called “the clothing of Ein Sof in Hochma.” And if it is from phase two, it is called “the clothing of Ein Sof in Bina.” And from phase one, it is called “the clothing of Ein Sof in ZA, or in Tifferet.” And although in every clothing there are ten Sefirot of direct light and of reflected light, nevertheless every clothing is named only after the uppermost Sefira in the level. (Chapter 3, Item 4)
